headline: Approved a $6M bond for FY27 city vehicles and a $434,264 jail diversion grant, plus several smaller grants and a resolution.
summary: The council approved a $6M bond authorization for FY27 city vehicles. It also approved grants, including $434,264 for a jail and arrest diversion program and $100,000 for CIT training. It approved a Head Start and Early Head Start resolution and accepted a $100 library donation.
decisions: Approved the FY27 CMF Gaming Harm Project grant of $75,000 with no match required, 12-0.
Approved the Parks FY27 Greening the Gateway Cities Program Implementation Grant of $75,000, 12-0.
Approved the CIT Training Reimbursement Grant of $100,000 with no match, 12-0.
Approved the Jail / Arrest Diversion Program Grant of $434,264.00 with no match required, 12-0.
Approved payment of the $48 prior-year bill from HR/LR, 12-0.
Approved acceptance of the $100 donation from Barbara Garvey to the Indian Orchard Branch Library, 12-0.
Approved the $6M bond authorization for FY27 city-wide vehicles, 13-0.
Approved the Head Start and Early Head Start resolution, 13-0.

City Council  
     
Regular Meeting 
 
~Final~ 
   
 
36 Court Street  
Springfield, MA 01103   
http://www.springfieldcityhall.com 
 
Gladys Oyola-Lopez 
 
October 5, 2026 6:30 PM City Hall - Room 200 
 
 
 
Roll Call 
COUNCILORS SANTANIELLO AND PEREZ WERE REMOTE FOR THIS MEETING. 
COUNCILOR FENTON ARRIVED LATE AT 6:42PM, COUNCILOR BROWN ARRIVED 
AT 7:22PM. 
Moment Of Silence - Pledge Of Allegiance 
 
Reports Of Committee 
COUNCILOR WALSH REPORTED ON THE ELDER AFFAIRS MEETING THAT WAS 
HELD LAST WEEK TOPIC WAS SENIOR SCAMS.  SPD ADVISED TO NOT PICK UP 
THE PHONE. 
COUNCILOR GOVAN REPORTED ON THE FINANCE COMMITTEE MEETING FROM 
9/28, THE SPRINGFIELD PARKING AUTHORITY WAS THE TOPIC.  THEY ALSO MET 
TODAY BEFORE THIS MEETING TO DISCUSS FINANCE ITEMS ON THE AGENDA. 
COUNCILOR MARTIN STATED THAT PUBLIC SAFETY AND HEALTH AND HUMAN 
SERVICES HELD A JOINT MEETING AND THE TOPIC WAS KRATOM AND HOW TO 
CONFISCATE LEGALLY. 
COUNCILOR DAVILA REPORTED ON THE ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE 
MEETING FROM 9/24. 
 
Informational 
 1. FY 2026 June Revenue Vs. Expenditure Report  
COMPTROLLER PATRICK BURNS SPOKE ON THE REPORT. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO ASKED SPECIFICS IN THE FINAL REPORT. 
COUNCILOR FENTON STATED THE SPECIAL COMMITTEE ON TARGETED TAX 
RELIEF HAS BEEN MEETING REGULARLY.  APPLICATIONS WILL BE GETTING 
DISTRIBUTED NEXT WEEK.
COUNCILOR CLICK BRUCE WOULD LIKE THE BODY TO SEE WHERE THE 
MARIJUANA FUNDS CAN BE USED.

Walsh, Justin Hurst, Victor Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado,
